topic: The Mystery of Pi: Definition and History

sections.title: The Hook: The Constant Ratio
animations: Draw a circle with center (0,0) in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Defining Pi: The Mathematical Formalization
lecture_lines: Pi is the circle's circumference divided by diameter.
It is an irrational, endless decimal number.
The sequence of digits never repeats.
animations: Display formula π = C / d in #FFFFFF.
Animate ratio calculation C/d as circle resizes.
Label C and d near the circle components.

sections.title: Historical Evolution: The Polygon Method
lecture_lines: Archimedes used polygons to estimate Pi.
Polygons inside circles mirror their shape.
More sides mean a closer approximation.
This method was used for centuries.
It eventually led to accurate calculations.
animations: Inscribe a square inside the circle in #FFFFFF.
Flash polygon sides to highlight growth.
Fade out polygon to show circle silhouette.

sections.title: Global Perspectives: Ancient Approximations
lecture_lines: Zu Chongzhi calculated Pi very precisely.
Ancient civilizations valued this mathematical constant.

sections.title: Conclusion and Application
lecture_lines: Pi is a fundamental universal constant.
Engineers use it for complex designs.
It is essential for space exploration.
Pi connects mathematics to the physical world.
animations: Display icons for engineering and space in #FFFFFF.
Animate circle radius expanding into space.
